summary.zh-TW: 滑鼠在卡片上移動時，卡片朝游標的方向傾斜，表面的反光跟著移動，標題和卡號浮在卡片前面一點。離開後慢慢回正。
summary.en: As the cursor moves over the card it tilts toward it, a glare drifts across the surface, and the title and number float slightly in front. It settles back when you leave.

text.zh-TW: 外層設定透視距離，裡面的卡片轉動時才有立體感。數字越小越誇張，像把卡片貼近眼睛看。
text.en: Perspective on the outer element gives the rotating card depth. Smaller values exaggerate it, as if the card were closer to your eye.

text.zh-TW: 把滑鼠在卡片上的位置換算成 -0.5～0.5，中間是 0，再乘上最大角度。左右移動繞 Y 軸轉，上下移動繞 X 軸轉。
text.en: The cursor position becomes -0.5 to 0.5 (centre is 0), times the max angle. Horizontal movement rotates around Y, vertical around X.

text.zh-TW: 標題往前浮 40px、卡號 24px，轉動時會和卡片表面分開，產生前後層次。外層要加 transform-style: preserve-3d。
text.en: The title floats 40px forward and the number 24px, separating from the surface as it rotates. The card needs transform-style: preserve-3d.

text.zh-TW: 只在有滑鼠的裝置啟用。手機沒有「游標停在卡片上」這件事，硬做會很奇怪。
text.en: Only enabled with a mouse. Phones have no “cursor over the card”, so forcing it feels odd.
